_comment: StepFun Chat Completions (direct API and Step Plan). Only documented parameters are accepted: undocumented OpenAI parameters and out-of-range values are refused before sending. Exactly one output limit goes out as max_tokens. Each Model has its own reasoning_effort ladder. Images are carried natively (vBot has no StepFun video encoder), at most 60 per request (documented).

admission.message: This Model requires an audio or realtime endpoint that this Connection does not support.

rules.note: Exact task-only routes documented 2026-10-15 in https://platform.stepfun.com/docs/zh/api-reference/audio/{create-audio,asr,asr-sse,asr-stream,transcriptions}, /api-reference/realtime/chat and /guides/models/stepaudio-3-{gen,music}. Step-Audio chat Models remain available; their audio names alone are not exclusions.

admission.message: This StepFun Model is retired; choose another StepFun Model.

rules.note: Exact retired Models from https://platform.stepfun.com/docs/zh/guides/models/deprecations (read 2026-10-15); image endpoints also retired on 2026-10-10.
Step 3.5 Flash 2603 takes reasoning_effort low or high.
Step 3.7 Flash and Step Router V1 take reasoning_effort low, medium or high.
